wiki.title: Giant Toad
wiki.text:
The Giant Toad is an enemy in Free Realms, their is also an TCG card version of it. It is a member of Darrel Handy's "Stayin Alive" deck. http://www.freerealms.com/article/detail.action?articleId=221
